meta.name: Accessibility
meta.description: Accessibility and readability settings, placed in Setting and contained by System. Supports adjusting font scaling, enabling/disabling captions and reduced-motion preferences, querying installed and enabled assistive services, and requesting activation or deactivation of a specified service through simulated authorization. Font levels and assistive-service capabilities are read-only configuration. Normalized scales must state their mapping to platform levels; synthetic increments are not native cross-platform constraints. Denied authorization leaves service activation unchanged. Screen-reading capability depends on the services actually enabled; setting a preference alone must not imply that all content can be read aloud. Uses system-settings simulation; querying service state does not mean an ordinary application has permission to enable it.

kwargs.name: font_scale_level
kwargs.description: Selected normalized font scale level. Each value refers to an entry in font_levels rather than to a native cross-platform platform constant.

kwargs.name: font_levels
kwargs.description: Read-only font-level configuration keyed by level ID. Normalized percentages are synthetic simulation values: small is 85%, default is 100%, large is 115%, and extra_large is 130%. Platform adapters map these values to the nearest supported Android, HarmonyOS, or OpenHarmony level; the increments are not native cross-platform constraints.

kwargs.name: captions_enabled
kwargs.description: Whether the system caption preference is enabled. Availability and coverage of captions still depend on the content and application.

kwargs.name: reduced_motion
kwargs.description: Whether reduced motion is preferred. Applications may interpret this preference according to their own supported behavior.

kwargs.name: installed_services
kwargs.description: Read-only synthetic assistive-service catalog keyed by stable service ID. Each record contains a display name and immutable capability list.

kwargs.name: enabled_services
kwargs.description: Currently enabled assistive services keyed by installed service ID. Every value has the exact fixed record structure {"enabled": true}, with no copied name, capabilities, or additional fields. Authorized activation inserts that exact record under the selected service ID, and authorized deactivation removes the selected key. Installed service metadata and capabilities remain owned by installed_services.

kwargs.name: screen_reading_available
kwargs.description: Whether at least one key in enabled_services identifies an installed service whose immutable capabilities include screen_reading. This does not guarantee that every application or item of content can be read aloud.

get_font_scale_level.name: get_font_scale_level
get_font_scale_level.description: Return the selected normalized font scale level without changing any accessibility setting.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.font_scale_level: The selected normalized font scale level ID. (type=string)

set_font_scale_level.name: set_font_scale_level
set_font_scale_level.description: Select an existing normalized font level. The level must be a key in the read-only font_levels catalog. Its synthetic normalized percentage is mapped to the nearest level supported by the simulated platform and is not treated as a native cross-platform increment. Invalid level IDs leave the selection unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The requested font level does not exist in the read-only font_levels catalog.

get_font_levels.name: get_font_levels
get_font_levels.description: Return the read-only normalized font-level catalog and its nearest-supported-platform mapping policy.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.font_levels: Read-only font levels keyed by level ID, including synthetic normalized percentages and platform mapping information. (type=object)

get_captions_enabled.name: get_captions_enabled
get_captions_enabled.description: Return whether the system caption preference is enabled. This reports the preference, not whether particular content supplies captions.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.captions_enabled: Whether the system caption preference is enabled. (type=boolean)

set_captions_enabled.name: set_captions_enabled
set_captions_enabled.description: Enable or disable the system caption preference. This does not create captions for content that does not provide them.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_reduced_motion.name: get_reduced_motion
get_reduced_motion.description: Return whether reduced motion is preferred without changing the preference.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

set_reduced_motion.name: set_reduced_motion
set_reduced_motion.description: Enable or disable the reduced-motion preference. The setting expresses a preference and does not guarantee that every application suppresses all animation.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_installed_services.name: get_installed_services
get_installed_services.description: Return all installed synthetic assistive services and their read-only capabilities. Reading this catalog does not grant an ordinary application permission to enable a service.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.installed_services: Installed assistive services keyed by stable service ID with names and immutable capability lists. (type=object)

get_enabled_services.name: get_enabled_services
get_enabled_services.description: Return all currently enabled assistive services. Each returned dictionary value is exactly {"enabled": true}; service names and capabilities are available separately from installed_services. This is a system-settings simulation query and does not imply that an ordinary application can change the returned state.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.enabled_services: Enabled assistive services keyed by installed service ID, with every value exactly equal to {"enabled": true}. (type=object)

get_screen_reading_available.name: get_screen_reading_available
get_screen_reading_available.description: Return whether an enabled assistive service currently declares screen-reading capability. A true result does not guarantee that every application or item of content is readable.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.screen_reading_available: Whether at least one enabled service declares screen_reading capability. (type=boolean)

request_service_state.name: request_service_state
request_service_state.description: Request activation or deactivation of an installed assistive service through a resolved simulated authorization decision. The service ID must be a key in installed_services. If authorization_granted is false, enabled_services and screen_reading_available remain unchanged. If authorization is granted and activate is true, the operation inserts or retains enabled_services[service_id] with the exact value {"enabled": true}; no installed-service fields are copied into that record. If authorization is granted and activate is false, the operation removes service_id from enabled_services. Activation and deactivation are idempotent when the service is already in the requested state. After an authorized request, screen_reading_available is recomputed as true exactly when at least one remaining enabled-service key identifies an installed service whose capabilities list contains screen_reading; otherwise it is false. Invalid input or an unknown service ID causes no mutation. This unified system-settings simulation does not represent a generally available ordinary-application API.

service_id.name: service_id
service_id.description: Stable ID of an installed assistive service.

activate.name: activate
activate.description: True to request activation or false to request deactivation.

authorization_granted.name: authorization_granted
authorization_granted.description: Resolved simulated authorization result. False represents denial and guarantees that service activation state remains unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.authorization_granted: The resolved simulated authorization result supplied for the request. (type=boolean)
details.service_id: The installed service ID addressed by the request. (type=string)
details.enabled: Whether the specified service is enabled after resolving the request. (type=boolean)
details.changed: Whether the authorized request changed the specified service's enabled state. (type=boolean)
details.screen_reading_available: Whether any enabled service declares screen-reading capability after resolving the request. (type=boolean)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified service ID does not exist in installed_services.
error_codes.AUTHORIZATION_DENIED: Simulated authorization was denied; enabled_services and screen_reading_available remain unchanged.

meta.name: Alarm
meta.description: Alarm configuration application, placed in Application. Supports adding, querying, partially updating, deleting, enabling, and disabling multiple alarms. Stores hour, minute, label, enabled state, and a list of weekdays without duplicates. An empty weekday list represents a one-time configuration. Updates preserve unspecified fields and unrelated records.

kwargs.name: alarms
kwargs.description: Alarm records keyed by stable string IDs. Each record contains an hour from 0 through 23, a minute from 0 through 59, a label, an enabled state, and unique weekdays from 1 through 7. An empty weekday list represents a one-time configuration.

add_alarm.name: add_alarm
add_alarm.description: Add an alarm with the supplied hour, minute, label, weekdays, and optional enabled state. The system generates and returns a new stable string ID without changing existing records. Hour must be 0 through 23, minute must be 0 through 59, the label must contain 1 through 80 characters, and weekdays must contain no duplicate values outside 1 through 7. An empty weekdays list represents a one-time configuration. Invalid arguments leave the collection unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.alarm_id: The generated stable string ID of the new alarm. (type=string)

error_codes.INVALID: One or more supplied alarm fields are invalid.

get_alarm.name: get_alarm
get_alarm.description: Return the complete alarm record identified by alarm_id without changing state. The operation fails if the alarm ID does not exist.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified alarm ID does not exist.

update_alarm.name: update_alarm
update_alarm.description: Partially update an existing alarm. At least one of hour, minute, label, or weekdays must be supplied in addition to alarm_id. Omitted fields retain their previous values, enabled state is unchanged, and unrelated records are preserved. An empty weekdays list represents a one-time configuration. An unknown ID or any invalid supplied value leaves the collection unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.updated_alarm: The complete alarm record after applying the supplied updates. (type=object)

error_codes.INVALID: No update field was supplied or a supplied value is invalid.
error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified alarm ID does not exist.

remove_alarm.name: remove_alarm
remove_alarm.description: Delete the alarm identified by alarm_id while preserving every unrelated alarm record. An unknown ID causes the operation to fail without changing the collection.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.removed_alarm_id: The ID of the deleted alarm. (type=string)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified alarm ID does not exist.

enable_alarm.name: enable_alarm
enable_alarm.description: Set enabled to true for the alarm identified by alarm_id. All other fields and unrelated records remain unchanged. An unknown ID leaves the collection unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.enabled_alarm: The complete alarm record with enabled set to true. (type=object)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified alarm ID does not exist.

disable_alarm.name: disable_alarm
disable_alarm.description: Set enabled to false for the alarm identified by alarm_id. All other fields and unrelated records remain unchanged. An unknown ID leaves the collection unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.disabled_alarm: The complete alarm record with enabled set to false. (type=object)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The specified alarm ID does not exist.

meta.name: Battery
meta.description: Battery and power-saving settings, placed in Setting and contained by System. Supports querying battery percentage, charging state, external power connection, and battery temperature, enabling/disabling power-saving mode, and querying its effective state. Battery level, temperature, and charging state are read-only feedback that changes with simulation time and power conditions; setters cannot specify target measured values. Switching power-saving mode does not instantly change battery level. Charging is determined by external power and system protection conditions. Power-supply restrictions on power-saving mode are defined by a fixed simulation policy.

kwargs.name: battery_percent
kwargs.description: Read-only remaining battery charge as a percentage. Simulation ticks increase it while charging and decrease it while discharging.

kwargs.name: charging_state
kwargs.description: Read-only charging result. Discharging means external power is absent; charging means external power is present and charging is permitted; full means the externally powered battery is at 100 percent; not_charging means external power is present but temperature protection prevents charging.

kwargs.name: external_power_connected
kwargs.description: Read-only feedback indicating whether an external power supply is connected. This condition may be configured by the simulation world but cannot be changed through Battery tools.

kwargs.name: battery_temperature_celsius
kwargs.description: Read-only simulated battery temperature in degrees Celsius. Temperature moves toward 35 degrees while charging and toward 25 degrees otherwise.

kwargs.name: power_saving_mode
kwargs.description: User-requested power-saving mode. The request persists while external power is connected, but the fixed simulation policy prevents it from becoming effective on external power.

kwargs.name: power_saving_effective
kwargs.description: Read-only effective power-saving state. It is true exactly when power-saving mode is requested and external power is not connected.

get_battery_percent.name: get_battery_percent
get_battery_percent.description: Return the current read-only battery percentage without changing battery feedback or settings.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.battery_percent: Current battery charge from 0.0 through 100.0 percent. (type=number)

get_charging_state.name: get_charging_state
get_charging_state.description: Return the current read-only charging result without changing any battery state.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.charging_state: Current charging result: discharging, charging, full, or not_charging. (type=string)

get_external_power_connected.name: get_external_power_connected
get_external_power_connected.description: Return whether an external power supply is currently connected. This read-only feedback cannot be changed with Battery tools.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_battery_temperature_celsius.name: get_battery_temperature_celsius
get_battery_temperature_celsius.description: Return the current read-only simulated battery temperature in degrees Celsius without changing it.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.battery_temperature_celsius: Current simulated battery temperature in degrees Celsius. (type=number)

get_power_saving_mode.name: get_power_saving_mode
get_power_saving_mode.description: Return whether power-saving mode is requested. This may differ from its effective state while external power is connected.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

set_power_saving_mode.name: set_power_saving_mode
set_power_saving_mode.description: Enable or disable the power-saving request. The request is accepted on or off external power, but it is effective only while external power is disconnected. After the request changes, the effective state is recomputed from the request and external power condition. This operation does not immediately change battery percentage, temperature, or charging state. Invalid input is rejected and leaves state unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_power_saving_effective.name: get_power_saving_effective
get_power_saving_effective.description: Return whether power-saving mode is currently effective under the fixed supply policy. It is effective exactly when requested and external power is disconnected.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.power_saving_effective: Whether power-saving mode is currently effective. (type=boolean)

tick.description: For each elapsed simulation minute, first applies the fixed supply policy so power saving is effective only when requested without external power. When external power is absent, battery charge decreases by 0.1 percentage point per minute if power saving is effective and by 0.2 otherwise. When external power is present, the battery is below 100 percent, and temperature is from 0.0 through 45.0 degrees Celsius inclusive, charge increases by 0.5 percentage point per minute. External power supplies no charge outside that temperature range. Charge is clamped from 0.0 through 100.0 percent. Temperature moves by up to 0.2 degrees per minute toward 35.0 while charging and by up to 0.1 degrees per minute toward 25.0 otherwise. The final charging state is discharging without external power, full at 100 percent on external power, charging when connected and temperature permits charging, and not_charging when connected but temperature protection blocks charging.

effect_properties.name: battery_percent
effect_properties.description: Current charge used as the starting value for deterministic charging or discharging.

effect_properties.name: charging_state
effect_properties.description: Read-only charging result updated from the final supply, charge, and protection conditions.

effect_properties.name: external_power_connected
effect_properties.description: External supply condition that determines whether charging or discharging is possible.

effect_properties.name: battery_temperature_celsius
effect_properties.description: Battery temperature used by charging protection and updated toward the applicable thermal target.

effect_properties.name: power_saving_mode
effect_properties.description: Requested power-saving setting used to determine effective power saving.

effect_properties.name: power_saving_effective
effect_properties.description: Effective power-saving state used to select the disconnected discharge rate.

after_action.description: After a successful power-saving setting change, immediately recomputes the effective state under the fixed policy: power saving is effective exactly when it is requested and external power is disconnected. This recalculation does not alter battery percentage, temperature, or charging state.

effect_properties.name: external_power_connected
effect_properties.description: External supply condition that suppresses effective power saving while connected.

effect_properties.name: power_saving_mode
effect_properties.description: Requested power-saving setting.

effect_properties.name: power_saving_effective
effect_properties.description: Read-only effective state recalculated after the setting changes.

meta.name: Bluetooth
meta.description: Bluetooth settings, placed in Setting and contained by System. Supports enabling/disabling Bluetooth, scanning simulated nearby devices, querying devices, requesting pairing, unpairing, connecting, and disconnecting, with separate queries for pairing records, active connections, and profiles such as audio. Devices use stable IDs. Scanning, pairing, and connecting require Bluetooth to be enabled and comply with airplane-mode policy. Pairing confirmation may be denied, and a paired device is not guaranteed to connect. Disabling Bluetooth ends active connections but preserves pairing records. Unpairing removes the specified record and ends its connection without affecting other records. Connection capacity and supported profiles are read-only simulation capabilities.

kwargs.name: enabled
kwargs.description: Whether Bluetooth is enabled. Enabling does not scan, pair, or connect automatically.

kwargs.name: radio_allowed
kwargs.description: Whether the current phone airplane-mode policy permits Bluetooth radio use. A false value prevents enabling, scanning, pairing, and connecting.

kwargs.name: nearby_devices
kwargs.description: Deterministic simulated nearby devices keyed by stable device ID. Each record contains a display name, supported profile IDs, and a pairing confirmation outcome.

kwargs.name: paired_devices
kwargs.description: Persistent pairing records keyed by stable device ID. Each record retains the simulated device name and supported profiles.

kwargs.name: active_connections
kwargs.description: Active Bluetooth connections keyed by paired device ID. Each record identifies the connected profile. Records are cleared when Bluetooth is disabled or blocked by airplane-mode policy.

kwargs.name: supported_profiles
kwargs.description: Read-only Bluetooth profiles supported by this simulated phone, keyed by profile ID.

kwargs.name: connection_capacity
kwargs.description: Maximum number of simultaneously connected device records supported by this simulation.

get_enabled.name: get_enabled
get_enabled.description: Return whether Bluetooth is currently enabled.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

set_enabled.name: set_enabled
set_enabled.description: Enable or disable Bluetooth. Enabling is rejected when radio_allowed is false. Disabling immediately removes every active connection while preserving all pairing records. Invalid or blocked requests leave all state unchanged.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Bluetooth cannot be enabled while the effective airplane-mode radio policy blocks it.

get_radio_allowed.name: get_radio_allowed
get_radio_allowed.description: Return whether the effective airplane-mode policy currently permits Bluetooth radio use.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.radio_allowed: Whether current phone policy permits Bluetooth radio use. (type=boolean)

scan.name: scan
scan.description: Return the deterministic simulated nearby-device dictionary. Bluetooth must be enabled and permitted by airplane-mode policy. Scanning does not pair or connect any device and does not change state.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.nearby_devices: Nearby simulated devices keyed by stable device ID. (type=object)

error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Bluetooth is disabled or blocked by airplane-mode policy.

get_paired_devices.name: get_paired_devices
get_paired_devices.description: Return all persistent Bluetooth pairing records keyed by stable device ID. Pairing records remain available when Bluetooth is disabled.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.paired_devices: Persistent pairing records keyed by stable device ID. (type=object)

get_active_connections.name: get_active_connections
get_active_connections.description: Return all active Bluetooth connection records keyed by paired device ID.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.active_connections: Active connection records keyed by paired device ID. (type=object)

get_supported_profiles.name: get_supported_profiles
get_supported_profiles.description: Return the read-only dictionary of Bluetooth profiles supported by this simulated phone.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.supported_profiles: Supported Bluetooth profiles keyed by profile ID. (type=object)

get_connection_capacity.name: get_connection_capacity
get_connection_capacity.description: Return the read-only maximum number of simultaneous connected device records supported by this simulation.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

request_pairing.name: request_pairing
request_pairing.description: Request pairing with a simulated nearby device. Bluetooth must be enabled and permitted, and device_id must identify a nearby device. A record whose pairing_confirmation is denied causes a deterministic rejection and no state change. An accepted request creates or preserves the pairing under the same stable device ID without connecting it or changing unrelated records.

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: Stable ID of an existing simulated nearby device.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.device_id: Stable ID of the successfully paired device. (type=string)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The nearby device ID does not exist.
error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Bluetooth is disabled or blocked by airplane-mode policy.
error_codes.PAIRING_DENIED: The simulated device denied pairing confirmation.

unpair.name: unpair
unpair.description: Remove one existing pairing record by stable device ID and remove that device's active connection if present. Every unrelated pairing and connection record is preserved. An unknown ID is rejected without changing state.

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: Stable ID of an existing paired device.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The paired device ID does not exist.

connect.name: connect
connect.description: Connect one paired device using a supported profile. Bluetooth must be enabled and permitted. The device must be paired, the profile must be supported by both the phone and that device, and the active connected-device count must remain within connection_capacity. Repeating the same device and profile is idempotent. A failed request leaves every connection unchanged.

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: Stable ID of an existing paired device.

profile.name: profile
profile.description: Bluetooth profile to activate for the connection. (choices=['audio', 'input'])

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)
details.device_id: Stable ID of the connected device. (type=string)
details.profile: Profile used by the active connection. (type=string)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The paired device ID or phone profile ID does not exist.
error_codes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Bluetooth is disabled or blocked by airplane-mode policy.
error_codes.UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE: The paired device does not support the requested profile.
error_codes.CAPACITY_REACHED: Connecting the device would exceed the simulation connection capacity.

disconnect.name: disconnect
disconnect.description: Disconnect one actively connected device by stable device ID. The pairing record and every unrelated connection are preserved. An unknown active connection ID is rejected without changing state.

device_id.name: device_id
device_id.description: Stable ID of an actively connected device.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

error_codes.NOT_FOUND: The active connection ID does not exist.

dependency_changed.description: When the effective phone airplane-mode policy changes, updates radio_allowed. If the policy becomes blocking, Bluetooth is disabled and all active connections are ended while pairing records are preserved. A later permitted policy does not automatically re-enable or reconnect Bluetooth.

effect_properties.name: radio_allowed
effect_properties.description: Effective phone policy determining whether Bluetooth radio use is permitted.

effect_properties.name: enabled
effect_properties.description: Bluetooth enabled state, which is cleared when radio use becomes blocked.

effect_properties.name: active_connections
effect_properties.description: Active connections, which are cleared when radio use becomes blocked.

meta.name: Connectivity
meta.description: Cellular data and network availability settings, placed in Setting and contained by System. Supports querying SIM and cellular service state, enabling/disabling mobile data, setting data roaming permission, and querying the current upstream network and internet availability. SIM slot count is a read-only capability; signal strength, link state, and internet availability are read-only feedback. Effective mobile data availability requires a valid SIM, service coverage, and satisfied airplane-mode dependencies. Enabling the switch does not guarantee connection, and allowing roaming does not mean the device is currently roaming. Wi-Fi connection state is owned by WiFi; this module only references it in its aggregated view.

kwargs.name: sim_slot_count
kwargs.description: Fixed number of cellular SIM slots supported by this simulated phone.

kwargs.name: sim_state
kwargs.description: Read-only state of the SIM used for cellular data. Ready indicates a valid usable SIM, absent indicates no SIM, and invalid indicates a present but unusable SIM.

kwargs.name: service_state
kwargs.description: Read-only cellular service feedback. Home and roaming indicate coverage, while unavailable indicates that cellular service cannot currently be used.

kwargs.name: mobile_data_enabled
kwargs.description: Whether use of cellular mobile data is requested. Enabling this setting does not by itself guarantee a cellular connection or internet access.

kwargs.name: data_roaming_enabled
kwargs.description: Whether cellular data use is permitted while roaming. This permission does not indicate that the phone is currently roaming.

kwargs.name: signal_strength_percent
kwargs.description: Read-only normalized cellular signal strength from 0 through 100 percent. This synthetic percentage is feedback and does not by itself establish connectivity.

kwargs.name: cellular_link_state
kwargs.description: Read-only cellular data link feedback derived from the mobile-data setting, SIM state, service state, signal strength, roaming permission, and airplane-mode dependency.

kwargs.name: upstream_network
kwargs.description: Read-only aggregated upstream network selected by the simulation. An active Wi-Fi connection has priority over an eligible connected cellular link. Wi-Fi state remains owned by WiFi.

kwargs.name: internet_available
kwargs.description: Read-only deterministic internet-availability feedback for the selected upstream. It is true when dependency recomputation selects an active Wi-Fi connection or an eligible connected cellular link, and false when no upstream is selected.

get_sim_slot_count.name: get_sim_slot_count
get_sim_slot_count.description: Return the fixed number of cellular SIM slots supported by this simulated phone.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_sim_state.name: get_sim_state
get_sim_state.description: Return whether the cellular-data SIM is absent, invalid, or ready without changing its state.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_service_state.name: get_service_state
get_service_state.description: Return the current cellular service feedback as unavailable, home, or roaming. This does not change roaming permission.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

get_mobile_data_enabled.name: get_mobile_data_enabled
get_mobile_data_enabled.description: Return whether cellular mobile data is enabled as a user setting. The result does not by itself assert that a cellular link or internet access is available.

details.Return Code: The return code of this function, either "[PASS]" or one of Error Codes built-in or listed below (type=str)

set_mobile_data_enabled.name: set_mobile_data_enabled

meta.name: Privacy
meta.description: Application permission and privacy management, placed in Setting and contained by System. meta.name: ScreenCapture
meta.description: Screenshot and screen recording application, placed in Application and contained by System. Supports requesting simulated capture authorization, taking screenshots, starting and stopping screen recording, querying authorization and recording state, and querying or deleting screenshot and completed recording records by stable ID. Records contain only metadata such as type, time, and duration; no actual images or videos are generated. Authorization may be denied or revoked, and protected content or resource conflicts may block capture. Failures create no successful records, and repeated recording starts are rejected. Recording duration uses monotonic time. Normal stopping creates a completed record; authorization revocation or resource loss terminates recording with an explicitly marked interrupted result. Enabling microphone audio recording additionally requires Privacy authorization; screen capture authorization does not replace microphone permission.

kwargs.description: Current simulated screen capture authorization state. A granted state permits capture subject to the other interlocks. Explicit revocation interrupts an active recording.

kwargs.description: Current screen recording lifecycle state. Both normal stopping and interruption return this state to idle; the resulting metadata record identifies the outcome.

kwargs.name: microphone_audio_enabled

kwargs.name: microphone_access_granted

kwargs.name: capture_block_reason
kwargs.description: Read-only current capture block reason derived from the declared system capture-condition dependency. protected_content_active=true maps to protected_content regardless of resource availability; otherwise capture_resource_available=false maps to resource_conflict; otherwise the value is none.

kwargs.name: captures
kwargs.description: Metadata-only capture records keyed by stable IDs. A screenshot record has exactly type, capture_minute, duration_minutes, and result. A recording record has exactly type, start_minute, end_minute, duration_minutes, microphone_audio_included, result, and interruption_reason. Completed recordings use interruption_reason none; interrupted recordings use authorization_revoked, protected_content, resource_conflict, or microphone_authorization_revoked.

meta.name: Sound
meta.description: Sound settings, placed in Setting and contained by System. Supports separate media, ringtone, notification, and alarm volumes, switching among normal, vibrate, and silent modes, setting incoming-call vibration preferences, and selecting ringtones and notification sounds from local synthetic resources. Volumes are represented uniformly as 0–100%, with native-level mappings declared. Fixed platform rules linking volume streams must be explicit; all streams cannot be treated as one master volume. Focus affects interruption permission only and does not overwrite stored volumes. The virtual Space does not hold physical sound properties.
